title: Medical Laboratory Science

sourceText.admission:
Admission Requirements

• BIOL 180, BIOL 200, BIOL 220; CHEM 142, CHEM 152, CHEM 162 (or CHEM 143, CHEM 153; or CHEM 145, CHEM 155, CHEM 165); CHEM 237 (or CHEM 223 or CHEM 257); one of STAT 220, STAT 221/SOC 221/CSSS 221, STAT 311, or Q SCI 381; minimum 2.00 cumulative GPA in these courses

• Complete all general education requirements including 10 credits of Social Sciences (SSc), 10 credits of Arts and Humanities (A&H), and 5 credits of Diversity (Div) as well as all required Composition and writing courses.

Application Procedure: See program adviser for application form. Application deadline is February 15, to begin the following autumn quarter.

sections.credentialOverview:
Credential Overview

Medical Laboratory Science, offered by the Department of Laboratory Medicine, is a profession of highly knowledgeable and skilled individuals who perform clinical laboratory tests on patient samples. This is a critical part of healthcare, as the results obtained by these laboratory tests are a vital tool for physicians in their diagnosis, treatment and prevention of disease. The disciplines within Laboratory Medicine that students learn about and train in are: Clinical Chemistry, Hematology/Coagulation, Microbiology, Transfusion Medicine, Urinalysis and Clinical Research. Students will earn a BS degree in MLS and will be eligible to take the national certification exam, required of this profession, through the American Society of Clinical Pathology.
sections.programCompletionRequirements:
Completion Requirements

124-127 credits

• Courses Required for Admission (36-39 credits): See list above.

• Didactic Courses (52 credits): BIOC 405; IMMUN 441; MICROM 442, MICROM 443, MICROM 460; LAB M 301, LAB M 302, LAB M 400, LAB M 403, LAB M 404, LAB M 405, LAB M 418, LAB M 419, LAB M 420, LAB M 421, LAB M 426, LAB M 430, LAB M 435

• Clinical Rotations (36 credits): LAB M 423, LAB M 424, LAB M 425, LAB M 431, LAB M 436

• Minimum 2.0 grade in all didactic and clinical rotation courses

• Minimum 2.00 cumulative GPA in didactic and clinical rotation courses
